handoff: Approve: AC1-AC6 each proven by a test (handoffs-folder integration, run-state-move AC5, slice-workflow e2e AC6). base-sync handoff notes only restore each test's precondition (a norn commit of its own); assertions unchanged, branch pushes still at every boundary. unit 1208/0, typecheck clean, e2e 72 pass 2 skip. 3 non-blocking findings (checkout JSON handoff mixes status, literal pathspec, tidy untraced).

findings.title: story checkout --json units[].handoff now mixes rendered status with prose
findings.detail:
The JSON field that used to be the raw handoff text now starts with the status block, whose data already sits in step/status/park. A program reading --json gets presentation in a data field (P8 spirit). No schema covers it, so it's not a contract break.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Keep handoff as the prose and add the status lines in the markdown rendering only, or add a separate status field.

findings.title: Move pathspec excludes use glob magic
findings.detail:
`:(exclude)${specDir}/${n}` treats each entry name as a glob, so a name with *, ? or [ would exclude more or less than that entry.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Use `:(exclude,literal)` or `:(top,exclude,literal)`.

findings.title: The handoff tidy write is untraced
findings.detail:
tidyHandoff writes in act before the commit (fine for H2), but the action detail doesn't say whether it wrote (it returns a boolean that is dropped), so --why cannot show the one-time B8 cleanup.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Add `handoff_tidied: true` to the commit detail when tidyHandoff returns true.
